messages:
Maya: Quick sync — planning to pin model 'aurora-lite-v2' to catalog slot 42 tonight during quiet window 23:30-00:00 PT. Need a deploy owner + smoke checklist.
Priya: I can do QA. What's the exact variant & hash? Also need PR link.
Maya: variant=aurora-lite-v2, tag=2026-03-18T02, sha=ab12c4f. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1287
Jon: I can own the deploy. Will be on-call from 23:15. Plan: apply pin -> wait 2 min -> run smoke (10 queries) -> monitor 15m.
Sam: +1. Make sure auto-fallback is enabled to 'aurora-lite-v1' in case of OOM.
deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #1287 (build 526) :white_check_mark:
Priya: Smoke checklist:
- postman suite /smoke/run-pin
- run latency profile (p95) against canary
- verify token-level billing path
- logs for KV cache warming
Jon: Copy. Will post a short runbook snippet before deploy.
Maya: Runbook snippet: ```
steps:
1) kubectl apply -f pin.yaml
2) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/catalog/pin -d '{"slot":42,"model":"aurora-lite-v2","tag":"2026-03-18T02"}'
3) run smoke script: ./scripts/smoke-pin.sh 42
4) if 503s > 5% -> rollback
```
Ops-runner: Slot 42 reserved from 23:25-00:05 PT. Capacity check ok (2x compact GPUs free).
Priya: I'll run the postman suite and watch traces. Ping me when step 2 completed.
Jon: Deploying at 23:30. I will add release note in PR and tag @Priya @Maya
Maya: Approval? @lead-ops
Sam: Reviewing PR now. Minor lint in manifest. Will approve in 10.
Sam: Approved. :thumbsup:
Jon: Pin applied. Step 2 complete. URL: https://api.redwood.dev/catalog/pin/ops/410765
Priya: Running smoke... 10/10 passes, p95 latency +8ms vs baseline. Traces look clean.
Ops-runner: Metrics: cpu 18%, gpu mem 62%, tail latency stable.
Maya: Rolling forward. Monitor for 15m then mark pinned in tracker.
Jon: If errors spike I'll switch to fallback and open incident. For now stable.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll update the model-board and close the handoff.
